svg.text: PV Combiner / DC Isolators + SPD Type 2 (Rapid Shutdown Ready)
3-ph 400 V, 4 MPPT, grid + backup ports, Modbus to
BMS CAN to INV-1, DC breaker
ATS / Main Isolator 125 A + SPD Type
Earthing: TN-C-S, PV frames bonded, separate DC SPD earth; all to < 5 ohm ring.
Connected ~348k BTU/h (~25 kW elec); mountain climate, zoned scheduling
Kitchen, laundry, lighting, plugs, ERV, studio, network, pumps
Water: well, booster, treatment, irrigation pumps
Peak demand (coincident) about 32 kW: AC 17 kW + sauna 9 kW + range 4 kW + misc; with EV ~40 kW.
Assumptions: yield 1380 kWh/kWp/yr on ~4 degree roofs; tariff 4.5 THB/kWh (PEA residential incl. Ft); export credit 2.2 THB/kWh only for the first 10 kWp under the
PEA/ERC residential rooftop scheme (10-yr contract), surplus above that self-consumed or curtailed (zero-export). Installed cost ~30k THB/kWp incl. hybrid inverter; LFP
Recommendation: Option B. 20 kWp on the south-facing planes (master roof + living north half) plus the east wing, with a 30 kWh battery: about 77% of annual use from
solar, 9-yr payback, and 6-10 h of backup for essentials during mountain grid outages. The full roof (C) exports mostly unpaid power and never pays back. The north-facing
south-wing and studio roofs stay clear (lower yield, sauna/steam vents).
Clamp-on mounts to standing seam: no
roof penetrations; keep 0.5 m from eaves
solar (2025 measure, up to 200k THB) to
